authorization: User continued the proposed transition from Space to permissions/local-entry implementation. Root/module construction documents were not modified.
implementation: Scope.conversation permits null for direct-user local operations; conversation mode still requires a non-null identity.
Local mode requires affirmative trusted entryEnabled policy, moduleEnabled, globalEnabled, sourceAllowed and a persisted exact-scope grant. conversationEnabled is not inherited as a local policy.
Exact matching still includes subject, entry instance, nullable context, resource, action, target, relationship and relationshipGeneration. No grant union or default permission.
Trusted primitive facts are snapshotted before Store reads; changes cannot retarget a checked scope. Boolean gates require literal true.

recheck uses current trusted facts, current grants and existing revision/generation checks. Task and callback remain entry_policy_unresolved; old local hosts without the required facts remain blocked.
Explicitly closed local entry returns deny; missing independent entry policy remains indeterminate.

verification.command: node --test permissions/tests/local.test.mjs (explicitly-closed entry regression before fix)

consumer_evidence.injected_component: Trusted host request identity and management approvals are explicit fixtures; not production OS/IPC authentication.
assertions: No grant: Context body is not created.
Create/read/edit require independent exact grants, conversation:null.
Revocation denies original-intent result replay; independent read grants remain current.
Different window identity cannot read the Context.
Entry disabled between initial permission evaluation and body commit: Context body remains null.
Renderer self-claims and unapproved management requests do not create a grant or Context.

compatibility.existing_conversation_scopes: Existing nonempty string-conversation grants and readers pass unchanged tests.
compatibility.local_storage: Null-conversation local grants/revokes survive SQLite close/reopen.
compatibility.downgrade: Older builds reject local null-conversation grant records; downgrade support is not claimed.

limits: The actual app TrustPort still needs trusted user/window/IPC identity binding and entry lifecycle integration. No production UI identity path is enabled by this change.
The CLI default remains untrusted; no default grants or automatic approval were added.
Windows/ACL, IPC authentication/replay protection and external side-effect race barriers remain unverified.
Conversation four levels, workflow/task policy, callback policy and special trust-root rules are not implemented or approved by this batch.
Root README and permissions README contain earlier Space-only/nonconversation-blocking status. Their status/navigation update remains a separate acceptance/document-maintenance step.
next: App trusted entry and lifecycle assembly using public interfaces, after status/navigation reconciliation.
